About this experience

This hidden gem is a whole new pottery experience. Nestled in a lush, leafy garden in Tiong Bahru, you'll spend a blissful few hours getting your hands delightfully muddy under the expert eye of a true creative designer. Forget run-of-the-mill bowls and mugs – think quirky sloth cups, or plates adorned with your gorgeous fur babies. This is hand-building pottery with an extra dose of personality! What to expect Leave everyday stress at the garden gate – this is your creative oasis. Learn the ancient art of hand-building pottery – no intimidating wheels here! Let your imagination run wild – your host will guide you to bring those unique piece ideas to life. Celebrate a special occasion? You can customize your ceramic creation for birthdays, proposals...the sky's the limit! Kiddos in tow? They'll love this pottery adventure where they create and paint their piece in one fun session. Important tips This cozy experience needs at least 2 people to run. Perfect for a creative date or gathering a small group of friends! Your one-of-a-kind masterpieces will need 3-4 weeks for glazing and firing before you take them home.

What to expect

You'll arrive to a studio that smells unreasonably good. After a short intro on wax types and fragrance blending, you'll choose your scent combination from over 30 options and pick your vessel — from classic tins to ceramic pots.

The pouring process takes about 45 minutes. While your candle sets, Sarah walks you through care tips: why cotton wicks matter, how to get a clean burn, and how to re-use the vessel once the wax is gone.

You'll leave with one completed candle (plus any extras you make if time allows). No experience needed — if you can pour a cup of coffee, you can make a candle.

About the host

🪴

Emily Lim

Emily's backyard pottery studio is a hidden gem! A former creative designer, she's got a knack for turning your wildest ideas into beautiful ceramic pieces. Emily's warm, patient style and years of experience make her the perfect guide on your pottery journey.
